**Building from scratch: a £100m 4-4-2 with B.Fernandes as captain and 43.55 projected points.**

**✅ What's strong**
The engine room does the heavy lifting. B.Fernandes (5.02 xP) is the standout — nailed, on pens, free-kicks and corners #1, and he takes the armband. Behind him you've got serious defensive value in Gabriel (4.56 xP, vice-captain) and Virgil (3.97), both nailed threats with soft fixtures. Enzo is a tidy 3.62 xP differential set-piece option. No fitness flags to sweat over this week — clean bill of health across the board.

**🔄 What I'd change**
Watch the rotation risks: Gabriel (~66'), Saka (~56'), Mbeumo and João Pedro (~68') all carry minutes doubts, while Calafiori (~50', cameo) is the weak link in the XI — Shaw (2.54 xP, nailed) sits ready on the bench if that one wobbles. Thiaw (2.42) and Leno (2.02) are functional value picks that free up the budget for the big guns. It's a fresh build, so no hits — lock it in.

**Bottom line: Load up on the Arsenal and United threats, captain B.Fernandes, and trust the 43.55.**
